referenceFunction.generalComment: The yearly production of whey is 2800 m3. The fermentation of this amount results in a yearly biogas production of 122550 m3. Thus, 22.8 kg whey are required for the production of 1 m3 biogas. Whey digestion fulfils only one functions: production of biogas. ; UUID: 0dc256dd-5a79-3ddc-87f6-a33b4ce283cd
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Data represents the environmental exchanges due to the digestion of whey. Emissions due to gas purification and the use of the gas for co-generation are not included. Digested matter is treated in a wastewater treatment plant.
